account: In a SKAI interview reported on May 18, 2026, Deputy Minister of Transport Konstantinos Kyranakis described an AI system that transcribes GSM-R communications between stationmasters and train drivers. He said that it would identify departures from railway communication protocols so that the control center could intervene. He said that the system had been presented the previous Saturday. The interview supplies no developer, operational start date, transcription accuracy, alert counts, or measured safety result.

ai_role.statement: Kyranakis described speech transcription and checks against communication protocols. The original interview does not establish that the system was operating routinely or that an alert prevented an incident.

The interview supplies no developer, operational start date, transcription accuracy, alert counts, or measured safety result.
